submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE independently hand-drawn native square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite of this exact celestial musician girl. Single pose, one character, no sheet. Image1=identity and immutable hand ownership, Image2=direction and camera reference, Image3=approved clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style; any Image4 is same-direction scale/continuity anchor. Keep purple high bun long hair, gold lotus/pearl crown, violet eyes, ivory-lavender-gold embroidered long sleeves, short tunic over puffy lavender trousers, ivory-purple boots, green waist knot, ONE rigid elongated flat purple-gold qin. Anatomical LEFT supports upper qin, anatomical RIGHT rests/grips lower string face, both hands continuously attached during run. Both shoulders and elbows rotate naturally with stride while retaining grips, no hand swap. Two arms and two legs only, coherent hips/knees/ankles and boot toes; do not hide all feet under skirt. Preserve actual alpha, translucent ribbons. Full silhouette within clear margins. Same global head/body size and camera, no zoom, no individual bbox fit or grounded recentering. Virtual canvas 1024 root(512,942), floor92%canvas. Head crown around13%canvas in contact phase and boots near92%, with small true run bob. STRICT SOUTHWEST: front three-quarter view running diagonally TOWARD lower-left. Face and chest readable looking lower-left, not frontal and not profile. Anatomical LEFT side is nearer, RIGHT farther. Anatomical LEFT hand on upper qin at screen-right, RIGHT hand on lower string face at screen-left. Trace both wrists to correct shoulders. FRAME SW08 of16, cycle cadence to review at640/720/800ms: LEFT SOFT TOUCHDOWN. Near anatomical LEFT leg emerging SCREEN RIGHT stays SCREEN RIGHT on landing: LEFT boot at(58%,92%) flat just receiving body, left knee slightly bent. Far RIGHT leg emerging SCREEN LEFT now trails backward and its small right boot is lifted at(40%,84%). Exact opposite foot placement from SW01. Do NOT lead with screen-left boot in this frame. Two separate thigh/boot chains: near left SCREEN RIGHT planted low, far right SCREEN LEFT lifted high. Torso shifts over near left hip. Qin and elbows counterrotate left shoulder back/right forward with immutable left-upper and right-lower hand grips. Hair, sleeves and ribbons lag naturally and change with gait. No background, ground, shadow, text, border, particles, glow, motion lines, trails, extra props. Highest visual finish; project target2.5Sunburst/max is host-managed, not a submitted model parameter.
